# saga-orchestrator

> In-process saga orchestrator: ordered steps, reverse-order compensations, bounded retries and resumable persisted state. Python package `trysac-saga-orchestrator`, import name `saga_orchestrator`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
